title: 2x Plug Plants Broad Bean Pink Karmazyn Compact High Yield Variety
description:
Broad Bean ‘Pink Karmazyn’ is an unusual variety with pink seeds, good flavour, and high yields. Plants are compact and robust, making them suitable even for exposed sites.



Height: approx. 60cm



Pods are best picked young for tender beans that cook quickly and hold their colour



Reliable cropper for allotments and gardens



Easy to grow, suitable for most soil types
